note: H3 reproducible-build environment record. The macOS DMG evidence in the H-phase governance was produced under the environment below. `npm ci` against the tracked package-lock.json reproduces the exact dependency tree regardless of host; the toolchain versions here pin the build host itself. Distribution target is Apple Silicon (arm64) only for the v2.0.x public release.

toolchain.node: >=22.0.0 (engines pin); build host recorded at H3: v25.5.0
toolchain.npm: >=10.0.0 (engines pin); build host recorded at H3: 11.8.0

installMode: npm ci (clean install from package-lock.json; lockfileVersion 3)

platformSupport.note: The v2.0.x public release ships Apple Silicon (arm64) only. Intel/universal are NOT built and must not be implied.

reproducibilityBounds: Deterministic to the pinned lockfile + exact electron/electron-builder versions. Electron downloads a prebuilt runtime keyed to its exact version. Not bit-for-bit reproducible across differing OS/codesign identities (signing is applied in H6), but the input closure is fully pinned.
